scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana
department: Backward and Extremely Backward Class Welfare Department
description: Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana is a scholarship scheme launched by the Backward and Extremely Backward Class Welfare Department, Government of Bihar. The scheme encourages academic excellence among students belonging to the Extremely Backward Class (BC-I) by providing a one-time financial incentive to those who pass the Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) Matric examination with first division.
objectives: Encourage academic excellence among Extremely Backward Class students.
Promote higher education after successful completion of the Matric examination.
Provide financial assistance to meritorious students.
Reduce financial barriers to further education.

benefits.title: One-Time Scholarship
benefits.description: A one-time scholarship of ₹10,000 is provided to each eligible student.

benefits.title: Direct Benefit Transfer
benefits.description: The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Student
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a student.

eligibility.title: Category
eligibility.description: The applicant must belong to the Extremely Backward Class (BC-I) category.

eligibility.title: Educational Qualification
eligibility.description: The applicant must have passed the Class 10 (Matric) examination in First Division from the Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB), Patna.

application_steps.title: Contact School
application_steps.description: Eligible students should contact their respective schools and ensure that all required documents are available.

application_steps.title: Submission of Eligible List
application_steps.description: The Bihar School Examination Board submits the list of eligible students to the Education Department.

application_steps.title: Verification
application_steps.description: The concerned authorities verify the student's identity and submitted documents.

application_steps.title: Approval
application_steps.description: The authorized officer of the Education Department approves the scholarship for disbursement.

application_steps.title: DBT Payment
application_steps.description: The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account through DBT.

documents_required.name: Caste Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Proof of Extremely Backward Class (BC-I) category.

documents_required.name: Residence Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Proof of permanent residence in Bihar.

documents_required.name: Matric Mark Sheet
documents_required.remarks: Proof of passing Class 10 in First Division from BSEB.

documents_required.name: Other Supporting Documents
documents_required.remarks: Any additional documents required by the concerned authorities.

important_notes: Only students who secure First Division in the Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) Matric examination are eligible.
The scholarship is provided only once per eligible student.
Scholarship amount is transferred through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
The list of eligible students is forwarded by the Bihar School Examination Board to the Education Department.
Students should ensure that all required documents are available with their respective schools.

faqs.question: How much scholarship is provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligible students receive a one-time scholarship of ₹10,000.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for this scholarship?
faqs.answer: Permanent residents of Bihar belonging to the Extremely Backward Class (BC-I) who have passed the BSEB Matric examination with First Division.

faqs.question: How is the scholarship amount paid?
faqs.answer: The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

faqs.question: Is an online application required?
faqs.answer: No. The process is handled offline through the student's school, the Bihar School Examination Board, and the Education Department.

faqs.question: Which documents are required?
faqs.answer: Caste Certificate, Residence Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Matric Mark Sheet, Bank Passbook/Bank Account Details, and any other required documents.
